an7.80:1.1: Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato vinayadharo sobhati.
an7.80:1.7: ubhayāni kho pan' assa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anuvyañjanaso,
an7.80:1.9: āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.80:1.10: Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato vinayadharo sobhatī
